data.name: Kathika
data.gender_notes: Kathika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Katha' meaning 'story' or 'account', Kathika represents purity and cleansing. In Hindu mythology, Kathika is the name of a constellation believed to bring good fortune and prosperity. It is also the name of a revered goddess, symbolizing the purifying power of water and knowledge. The name Kathika carries the meaning “Purity, Cleansing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kathika usually hope their child will grow to embody purity, cleansing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner cleansing and wisdom gained through knowledge and spiritual practices.
data.etymology: Kathika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Purity, Cleansing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kathika total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
